description: Extracts one frame per visual change from a video (slides, reels with typed text, image slideshows): a frame is saved when the picture has settled after changing, so text is complete and images fully shown. Output: frames/NNN_<seconds>s.jpg plus a result.json index.

video.description: Storage key of the video file.

settleSeconds.description: How long the picture must stay still before it is saved (default 0.6). Raise it for slow typing.

minChange.description: Fraction of pixels that must differ from the last saved frame to count as new (default 0.2%, i.e. 0.002).
